scope: Canonical packed 2D salmon dependency only. Approved native body/knife/rig/rest/actions/materials/light/camera remain the basis. No new body style work, target changes, runtime variants, candidate approval or source edit in preparation.

canonicalFood.representation: Honest packed RGBA 2D billboard inside native 3D chef; knife/body stay native 3D.
canonicalFood.policy: Exact complete approved RGBA bytes, full UV 0..1 and full 731:505 aspect. No new crop, color grade, alpha processing, repaint, or substitute native food model. Retain source STRAIGHT alpha, sRGB interpretation, Linear interpolation, CLIP extension, FLAT projection and unchanged transparent/emission shader.

actualSourceFoodLaw.sourceAlpha1Caveat: Legacy UV window includes alpha-1 specks/margin down to row 1197, while the visible plate lower edge at alpha>=128 is row 1050. Quad bottom and alpha-1 crop bottom are not the semantic plate support.
actualSourceFoodLaw.supportDefinition: For alpha>=T, choose the lowest occupied top-origin row. Support X is the midpoint of the first/last occupied pixel centers on that row, even if the row contains gaps; Y is that row pixel center (row+0.5). This explicit pixel-center convention is shared by source and canonical measurements.
actualSourceFoodLaw.sourceSupportInterpretation: Semantic support is the measured plate artwork point transformed through the actual food plane. The actual food-root/hand control, two evaluated palm-mesh centroids, native hand bones, and rest mouth metadata are different things. Do not invent quad-center, mouth or physical symmetric two-hand contact. The source visible plate point lies about 0.4509 logical px right and 7.6796 logical px above actual palm mean; preserve this authored projected path.

sourcePhaseVisibility.idle: food plane render-hidden all 12 frames/all 4 facings
sourcePhaseVisibility.work: food plane render-hidden all 12 frames/all 4 facings; native knife retains original work behavior
sourcePhaseVisibility.hold: food plane render-visible all 12 frames/all 4 facings before natural native occlusion
sourcePhaseVisibility.load: food plane render-visible all 12 frames/all 4 facings before natural native occlusion; source reach and return keeps dish attached

actualSourceFoodLaw.sourceFacingAndDepth: Yaw driver remains-facing; plane X rotation 55 degrees makes billboard screen-parallel for the fixed35 degree camera. Source local X/Y offset drivers use amplitude 0.39319298125871605 and source local Z 0.27531668543815613, giving one 0.6-world-cell camera-ray display offset. No food-root drivers or per-frame/per-view placement fitting.
actualSourceFoodLaw.nativeMouthAndHandCaveat: Evaluated smile-mesh centroid, hand bones, palm-mesh supports and rest mouth metadata were independently recorded for all 192 frames in the source audit. Metadata sockets alone do not certify the visible plate contact.

singleCanonicalMapping.derivation: Let source support S be obtained by affine inversion of source UV crop and alpha 128 support UV. Let W be unchanged source local width. Canonical H=W*505/731. With canonical alpha 128 UV(u_c,v_c), choose one constant vertex rebase delta=S-(-W/2+W*u_c,H*v_c,0). All four new quad vertices are the unshifted full-aspect quad plus this delta; UV is full0..1. This is one measured geometry mapping, not per-view fitting.

occupiedWidthPolicy.locked: Source quad/display width0.35000000149 world cells is preserved. No alpha-bound refitting or per-view scaling.
occupiedWidthPolicy.acceptedConsequence: Occupied alpha width changes naturally from the two exact artworks while full display width stays fixed; do not rescale canonical food to force old cropped alpha width.

singleCanonicalMapping.sensitivityInterpretation: Alpha 64/192 support variations are each below 0.123 native px /0.062 logical px after mapping. Alpha 128 is the frozen semantic point; no threshold switching to justify a candidate.
singleCanonicalMapping.oldCornerDifference: New canonical aspect/full UV necessarily changes the old cropped-source quad top corners. Source semantic support and fixed display width are preserved. The allowed depth-scalar test compares corners against this single derived canonical mapping, not against the incompatible old rectangle.

allowedOrthographicDisplayDepth.sameFor: Every state, frame and actual facing of this composition.
allowedOrthographicDisplayDepth.defaultRecommendation: Retain source D 0.6 unless a common permitted scalar demonstrably improves native display ordering. Choice is the editor implementation; it must be reported and reviewed.
allowedOrthographicDisplayDepth.worldLaw: P(D)=P_canonical_at_source D 0.6+(D-0.6)*cameraOut. Source food-root/action/palm paths remain unchanged.
allowedOrthographicDisplayDepth.localLaw: root scale 1.25, elevation 35 degrees: x=-sin(facing)*(D*cos35/1.25); y=-cos(facing)*(D*cos35/1.25); z=D*sin35/1.25; keep yaw=-facing and plane rotation.x=55 degrees. Equivalently preserve the source mechanism with one depth amplitude.
requiredInvariants: Every projected canonical quad corner matches the once-derived mapping for all 192 diagnostic poses.
The transformed alpha 128 semantic plate support projects to the original source support path.
Source root, food-root, palm, foot and native body/knife pose paths remain unchanged.
forbidden: A different depth, X/Y fit, scale, visibility gate, grade or camera for any direction/pose/frame.
Changing body, hands, food-root attachment, native choreography or action keys to make food fit.
Treating biased 2D display world bounds as physical one-cell body geometry.

mustMatch: All 95 physical body/knife native geometry/topology/UV/weights hashes; rig rest matrices/bone parents/deform settings; unchanged armature/object modifier behavior.
All 24 original cohort action curves, keys, interpolation, timing, action owners and driver structure except the one declared food ray amplitude. No extra runtime clips.
All source physical body/knife evaluated poses, foot/palm supports and food-root matrices for all 192 poses; source mesh counts and deformation remain stable.

Body materials, world/light setup, camera/projection/root/scale, AgX settings and registered capture values. Food shader nodes/defaults/links/alpha behavior remain source-identical except exact canonical image binding.

numericalTolerances.unchangedNativeMeshWeightActionShaderDat: Exact serialized content/hash equality under supplied baseline script; compare semantic data rather than arbitrary .blend file hash after food replacement.
numericalTolerances.packedCanonicalRGBA: Exact file and packed byte SHA256.

sourceRepeatObservation.limitation: One hold-S frame under the recorded same-session source settings. Does not establish blanket deterministic identity across rerenders, hardware, sessions, or new food radiance.

strictApprovedNativePreservation.radianceAndNoiseInterpretation: Independent same-source hold-S0 repeats differ at 10 pixels by only1 RGB byte level with unchanged alpha. This one measured sample is not a blanket PNG-determinism guarantee or a universal noise tolerance. The exact new canonical emission/alpha content, and an allowed ray depth, can alter transported radiance or occlusion around food while every body shader/mesh/light remains unchanged. Separate observed source-repeat variation and food-driven radiance from native data changes using strict baseline comparison, masks/source controls and any necessary same-config food-disabled diagnostic. Native body/camera/material edits remain forbidden; unaccounted visible changes require investigation.

captureAndDelivery.framePolicy: Preserve 12 indexed frames 0..11, including authored repeats.192 native whole-canvas frames,16 unchanged 6x2 atlases 2304x1280, no added variant clips or dropped motion.
requiredEvidence: Reopened portable native source with exact packed canonical image and complete resource closure; no active old held-food shader binding or stale missing dependency.
Full source/native preservation comparison and all 192 frame camera/phase/root/food/palm/support/corner/visibility records with measured actual facing rotations.
All 192 native RGBA frames, exact16 original whole-canvas atlas layouts, all-frame intended/logical and enlarged light/gray/dark sheets.
Sixteen actual 12 fps playback clips with correct loop policy; source/candidate same-registration hold/load/work contexts and phone/logical-size use contexts.
Immutable hash-bound candidate packet including source, canonical dependency, validation, every required hero/frame/preview, delivery metadata and dependencies.

preparationConclusion.nextStep: Coordinator reconciles/freezes this versioned contract and visible criteria; original editor then makes food-only candidate; original judge later reviews exact sealed bytes.
